citations.claim: pre-impact state just above floor falling at ~19.9 m/s
first violating step: resting exactly on floor but moving upward at ~41.5 m/s, far above incident speed
total energy jumps from ~200J to ~862J at the floor bounce with no controller work

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial downward velocity from -18.06 to -2.0 (same dt/steps/gravity/size); gentle impact no longer triggers the energy-injecting correction and no rule is violated.

explanation: Single ball dropped from rest-energy ~200J hits the arena floor at step 231-232. With no controller work, the contact response should at most reflect velocity with e=0.9 (outgoing <= ~18 m/s) but outgoing vy is +41.47 m/s, more than doubling speed, raising energy to ~862J vs allowed ~225J. The e=0 variant still gains energy (200->279J with outgoing +23.5 m/s from -19.9 m/s), so restitution is not the cause; the floor positional-correction/impulse adds spurious upward velocity on a deep/fast penetrating contact, violating energy_bound.
vision_note: A single small ball drops to and contacts the bottom arena floor around steps 229-232, remaining essentially on the floor line through the violating step 232. No tunneling out of the arena, wall penetration, or controller waypoint motion is visible in these frames.
